scope: All JPEGs in assets/Data/Leky_foto and assets/Data/Seznamy_foto. Package identity and list medication fields, not exhaustive OCR, bounding boxes, clinical validation, or personal data transcription.

annotationPolicy.method: Images visually inspected by assistant; no OCR engine or evaluated mobile model used to generate labels. Python used only for image contact sheets, reference parsing, deterministic candidate lookup, and integrity checks.
annotationPolicy.nullMeaning: Not visible, absent, or not confidently transcribed. Never an inferred zero.
annotationPolicy.suklMatching: Only normalized name and strength candidates; pack text matches reported separately. selectedCode always null because exact SÚKL product identity was not adjudicated.
annotationPolicy.catalogueMatching: Name/strength matches preserve duplicate rows. name_only and not_found are not confirmed matches. Catalogue active substances are reference metadata, not visual labels.
annotationPolicy.calibration: AI-generated draft reference annotations, not independently human-verified ground truth. Exclude uncertainFields from strict field scoring. Keep all observations from an image and all splitGroup members together; also group linked product images if evaluating unseen products.
annotationPolicy.handwriting: Tentative readings may contain source errors. Keep printed, handwritten, and catalogue values separate. No clinical correction or dosing inference.
annotationPolicy.relatedPackageImageIds: Shared confirmed catalogue name/strength rows only, not proof of the same physical package, pack size, prescription, or clinical equivalence.
